notes:
Notes for the question "Who's the goat in football" (today is Oct 12, 2026). No place was given. "Football" could mean soccer or American football, and the question doesn't say which. This is an opinion question with no official answer. The results give the common answers for each sport below.

**Soccer (world football)**
- Yahoo Sports, in a June 2026 piece, frames the debate as Lionel Messi against Pelé. It noted that Messi turns 39 on June 24 and was trying to make Argentina the first back-to-back World Cup winner since Pelé's Brazil.
- Korea Times, July 13, 2026: it describes the Messi-Ronaldo era as ending after the 2026 FIFA Men's World Cup. Its subheading says momentum is shifting toward Messi after the 2022 and 2026 World Cups.
- Sportda's 2026 ranking names Lionel Messi as the greatest. It cites his eight Ballon d'Or awards, 672 goals for Barcelona, the 2022 World Cup title and more than 15 years at the top.
- Live Score Desk says Messi is widely regarded as the greatest soccer player of all time. It lists Pelé, Maradona, Cristiano Ronaldo and Cruyff as the other main candidates.
- Opinions differ. A fan-vote site, vote-the-goat.com, shows Cristiano Ronaldo first in its football ranking as of Oct 12, 2026. Its raw vote totals have Messi at 527.7K and Ronaldo at 527.1K. The site's headline ranking and its vote counts disagree about who is first.
- Rodri picked Kevin De Bruyne as his own GOAT.
- Overall, the results mostly point to Messi, with Ronaldo, Pelé and Maradona as the main alternatives.

**American football (NFL)**
- CBS Sports' top-100 list, updated for the 2026 season, puts Tom Brady first and Jerry Rice second. The headline reads "Tom Brady, Jerry Rice lead all-time list."
- Other 2026 lists agree on Brady. Sports Media X cites seven Super Bowl titles, five Super Bowl MVPs and three NFL MVPs.
- Sports Media X names Joe Montana, Peyton Manning and Patrick Mahomes as the closest competition.
- Brady himself has said otherwise. He named Jerry Rice the greatest football player of all time ("still the GOAT, without a doubt"), in an AMC documentary about the 49ers. That CBS article is about 8 months old.
- By position, a fan-vote site (GoatWars, updated Aug 2026) ranks Barry Sanders first among running backs. Sports Media X picks Jim Brown at running back.
- Overall, Brady is the usual pick for NFL GOAT, with Jerry Rice the main alternative.
